scenes.text: This tutorial covers Classifier Evaluation. Audit held-out predictions, nested cross-validation, calibration, leakage, and per-plate performance.
Open Classifier Evaluation from the Results and quality control section. Choose predictions with ground truth, split metadata, plate identifiers, probabilities, and model-run records.
In the main configuration area, configure class order, thresholds, calibration bins, grouping, bootstrap uncertainty, and leakage checks.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. evaluate held-out and per-plate behavior before using a classifier for biological conclusions.
When the workflow finishes, spaCR produces discrimination, calibration, confusion, leakage, and robustness reports.
